scope: offline decision labeling from retained, context-matched evidence; no robot or Jev control
decision_epoch: before a bounded recovery action is applied

LATERAL_RECOVERY.meaning: first-Walk normalized lateral residual for 14 seconds only

YAW_RECOVERY.meaning: first-Walk normalized yaw residual for 14 seconds only

COMBINED_RECOVERY.meaning: first-Walk normalized lateral and yaw residual for 14 seconds only

ABSTAIN.meaning: no recovery authorization; not a demonstrated physical stop maneuver

fixed_recovery_conditions.application: skill=Walk8m, transition=Stand->Walk8m and decision_epoch=first_walk_entry only, at the inherited controller bounds, reference, policy, PD/gains, observation, reward, evaluator and thresholds

state.state_id: stable identifier for a distinct predecision state, not a treatment identifier
state.observability_rule: all observables must exist at decision time; route error is current pose versus route, and strict margin is instantaneous, never a formal endpoint or treatment outcome

outcomes.storage: separate from state and keyed by exact state_id, SHA256 canonical context fingerprint and SHA256 canonical full predecision state fingerprint
outcomes.roundoff_role: arithmetic verification only; a paired gain within this tolerance is not an improvement

selection: CONTINUE when its complete observed off outcome meets nominal, physical and all-strict gates; it is preferred to unnecessary recovery

otherwise recovery is in scope only at Stand->Walk8m first_walk_entry; each recovery requires complete observed nominal, physical and all-strict gates plus a strictly smaller final endpoint norm than its own off, and no worse absolute final commanded-axis lateral or heading error
select a recovery only if exactly one is admissible and all three recovery cells and the off comparator are complete
otherwise ABSTAIN, distinguishing missing evidence, no admissible recovery and ambiguous admissible recovery
nonclaims: not evidence of transfer to unmatched states
not a physical STOP safety claim
